QuestInfo.name: Seal Stone of Ellin Forest
QuestInfo.0: You ran into someone from the past. Maybe #p2131000# in Ellin Forest knows something about the Seal Stone. You'd better go talk to #b#p2131000##k in the #bCamp Conference Room#k and find out.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2131000# says that she stored a rock in
#m300000011#, which the heroes left for her, and she thinks it might be the Seal Stone. Entering #m300000011# to verify whether the rock is actually a Seal Stone requires a #b#t4032325##k. #p2132000# in #b#m300010400##k apparently has the #b#t4032325##k.

#i4032325# #t4032325# #b#c4032325# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: You received the #t4032325# from #p2131003#. #p2131000# told you to head to the #m300000011#.

0.0: Why do you look different, Aran? Is it because you came through the broken clocktower?\r\n#L0# #bThat seems to be the case since I am also different from what you described.#l\n#k
0.1: Did you come here to recover your memory?\r\n#L0# #b(You tell her about the Seal Stone.)#l\n#k
0.2: There is a rock that you left in my care. Might that be the Seal Stone you are seeking, Aran?\r\n#L0# #bI certainly think so.#l\n#k

yes.0: I'm sorry, Aran. I'd love to go there myself, but I can't leave this post. You'll find #b#p2131003##k at the Altaire Camp.

no.0: I'm sorry, Aran. I'd love to go there myself, but I can't leave this post. And it's not like I have a spare key...

0.3: That thing? I'm keeping it at the #b#m300000011##k. The #m300000011# is locked, so we won't ever lose the valuable pieces of knowledge we have stored in there. #p2131003# is in charge of the #b#t4032325##k. Would you like to head over there?

1.0: You managed to get the #t4032325# from #p2131003#. Now, can you give me the keys? I'll leave #m300000011# open.

yes.0: The library can be accessed using the #bportal right above me#k. I left it open, so just go ahead and check it out.

item.0: You still haven't brought back the #b#t4032325##k? You'll find #b#p2131003##k at #b#m300000000##k, located on the outskirts west of town. Get the keys from him.
